issues.issue: Eight pipelines cannot support a binomial test with meaningful power.
issues.rationale: The planned exact test will be uninformative at n=8.
issues.proposed_fix: Report the proportion with an interval and frame the study as exploratory, or enlarge the sample.

issues.issue: Byte-identical may be too strict for timestamps.
issues.rationale: Outputs embedding timestamps would never match.

threats_to_validity: selection bias in the curated list
